verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair axis to compare across payment platforms, since some payment and orchestration products can be self-hosted. EBANX's evidence describes only EBANX-operated hosted services: API endpoints by tenant and environment, a hosted checkout, a dashboard and a sandbox. Nothing in the pack shows a self-hostable or on-premise deployment of the core product. Keeping the JWS private key in your own infrastructure is an adjacent security control, not self-hosting.
